overview_description.description:
Govly is building a market network for government contracting, like AngelList for government procurement. Govly connects OEMs, VARs, and prime contract holders in a single network, with real-time opportunities from non-public contract feeds and a suite of tools to streamline the bidding process from discovery to award.

Govly empowers businesses by tapping into government opportunities allowing them to monitor, curate, and analyze the federal procurement ecosystem and focus on the opportunities that give the best chance of success.

about_short_description.short_description: Govly is building a market network for government contracting, like AngelList for government procurement.

product.name: Opportunities
product.description: A platform to search and track government solicitations across federal, state, and local agencies with access to over 40 private federal contract vehicles.

product.name: Awards
product.description: A tool providing real-time and historical federal contract award data to analyze market trends and agency buying behavior.

product.name: Buyers
product.description: A database of agency buyer profiles with contact details, budget insights, and award history to support outreach and deal acceleration.

product.name: Contacts
product.description: A searchable network of government agency contacts, including contracting officers, with detailed contact information to facilitate outreach.

product.name: Workspace and Collaboration Tools
product.description: A platform feature enabling teams to collaborate, share insights, track opportunity statuses, and coordinate efforts in government contracting.
